integrity: All finite claims are reproduced by a standalone exact-arithmetic checker using exhaustive RREF enumeration and exact conjugation. No randomized, floating-point, or truncated search is used.
scientific_limitations: Complete only for \(3\times3\) matrices over \(\mathbb F_2\). The dimension equality \(t_3(\mathbb F_2)=6\) was already covered by the prior general dimension theorem; the new contribution is the exact optimal-space classification and orbit census. No assertion is made for \(n\geq4\).
title: Optimal weakly triangularizable subspaces of \(M_3(\mathbb F_2)\)
